summary: Defines a comprehensive theme object for the mobile application.
Includes color palettes, typography settings, and spacing constants.
Specifies various shadow styles for different UI components like cards and modals.
purpose: This file centralizes all design tokens, such as colors, spacing, and typography, used throughout the mobile application.
risks: No runtime validation is present; incorrect usage of theme values could lead to visual inconsistencies.
Hardcoded values might require manual updates across multiple files if design system changes occur.
No mechanism exists to handle theme switching (e.g., dark mode) as it is static.
